$comment: The identity area's alerts (spec 02 §18.2; spec 08 §7.8 group C), from the steward's ruling of 22 Nov: auth-endpoint-unlisted. L-SAT-09 adds the rest of the area's alerts (owed in catalog/owed.ts). The API halves write auth.endpoint_blocked (console's developer realm, admin's staff realm, verify with none); the query counts every line whose class is not blocked, so a line that lost its class counts as unlisted and the alert fails closed. One incident per service, the label held to the rule's sources: any other value, a missing one included, is the one label `other`.

alerts.name: auth-endpoint-unlisted
alerts.incident_cause: Requests for /api/auth/* paths the realm does not list, above their threshold in 15 minutes: a client or library change calling an unlisted path, or probing. Count: {{value}}.

metadata.check: The realm and release on the lines; the request lines with the same requestId and their cfRay; whether the count began with a release.
